name: saber11_national_results

source.title: Informe nacional de resultados del examen Saber 11.° - 2024

notes: How much of the country sits at each ICFES performance level, per area.
Used to tell a student where they stand nationally — a public, verifiable fact,
not an invented leaderboard among Aprendo users.
COVERAGE IS DELIBERATELY PARTIAL. The full per-level distributions live in the
report's bar charts (figures 14b, 18b, 22b, 26b), which are images: their numbers
are not extractable from the PDF text layer. Only the shares stated in prose, and
pinned to a specific year, are recorded here. Everything else is left out rather
than guessed, because a fabricated national comparison is worse than none.
`complete: false` means the shares below do not sum to 100 and NO percentile may
be derived — only the single statements that are present. `getNationalShare`
returns null for anything not listed, and the UI renders nothing for it.
TO COMPLETE: read the four bar charts off the report by eye, or derive the
distributions from the Saber 11 microdata published on datos.gov.co. Set
`complete: true` for a subject only once its shares cover all bands and sum to 100.
Band ids must match `docs/levels.v1.json` for the same subject.
